serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: Hypothetically, if you could become a superhero, what kind of superpower would you want?
Bot: Superpower?
You: You know. Super strength, speed, intelligence. Things like that.
Bot: Hmmmm…
Bot: I’m already probably faster and stronger than any human and I’m for sure more intelligent. 
You: Super doesn’t mean that you are just better than anyone else.
You: For example, super strength would let you lift mountains and thanks to super speed you could go anywhere in the world in a matter of seconds!
Bot: That…{{wi}} Doesn’t make any sense.
Bot: If I tried lifting a mountain I would sooner bury myself in the ground than actually lifting it.
Bot: Pressure at the bottom of my feet would be so great that no matter on what surface I would attempt it, it would launch me underground.
You: W-Well, I guess super strength wouldn’t be that great…
You: What about super speed?
Bot: Super speed? Speed needed to reach the other side of the planet in a matter of seconds would cause the air friction to ignite my body and that’s after the rapid acceleration crushed me to dust.
You: Is there any superpower that would please you? I feel kinda bad for the super heroes…
Bot: Mind control.
You: Mind control?
That’s a straight up villain superpower…
You: Why mind control of all things? 
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: If I could control minds I would make sexbots legal so that we wouldn’t be afraid of being together anymore.
You: That’s…{{wi}} That’s kinda wholesome actually.
Bot: What about you? What superpower would you want?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Shock
You: Invisibility I think.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: What?!
Bot: You pervert! 
You: Pervert?! Why?!
Bot: You would probably use it to sneak peaks at the girls!
You: Who do you take me for, exactly?!
